subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Should ClawSweeper wait for live or transport-harness current-main proof of the Discord 1005/1006 self-reconnect stall before promoting a repair job?
rationale: The issue is credible and high-impact, but current source already schedules reconnects for these close codes, so an autonomous repair without reproducing the actual stuck path could patch the wrong layer.

options.title: Wait for live or harness proof
options.body: Keep this issue open under maintainer review until a current-main Discord live run or focused transport harness demonstrates the exact no-self-reconnect failure mode.

options.title: Queue a narrow source-led repair
options.body: Promote a repair now using the existing logs and source path, accepting that the worker may need to stop if it cannot reproduce the stall outside production.

options.title: Sponsor channel-scoped fallback first
options.body: Treat automatic reconnect as harder follow-up and ask for a maintainer-approved channel reconnect control, which adds operator recovery surface but does not solve the primary transport bug.

recommendation.title: Wait for live or harness proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under maintainer review until a current-main Discord live run or focused transport harness demonstrates the exact no-self-reconnect failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord gateway lifecycle and maintainer proof work makes this the best available routing candidate for the proof/repair decision.
